meta.name: connect
meta.description: Configure or diagnose access to a requested source using available host tools. Use for source MCP setup; source configuration needs no engagement record and credentials stay with the host.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 配置并排查对指定数据源的访问连接
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要接入或排查某个数据源的访问连接。
copy.tagline_en: Configure and troubleshoot access to a requested data source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up or debug access to a data source.

howto.what: 帮你用本机已有的工具配置或诊断对某个数据源的访问(含源 MCP 设置)。凭据保留在主机上,也不需要 engagement record。
howto.when: 当你要求配置或诊断某个数据源的访问、做源 MCP 设置时接管;若由 @fde 调用,则复用它当前已消毒的 packet 与范围。

say.text: 帮我配置一下这个数据源的 MCP 访问
say.note: 用本机已有工具配置,凭据留在主机

say.text: 诊断一下我对这个源的访问为什么不通
say.note: 检查能力与连接,缺什么会如实说明

say.text: 这台主机还缺哪些工具才能连上这个源?
say.note: 如实报告缺失能力,不假装已装好

howto.what_en: Configures or diagnoses access to a requested source using the host's available tools, including source MCP setup. Credentials stay with the host and no engagement record is needed.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to configure or diagnose access to a source, or set up a source MCP. If @fde calls it, it reuses @fde's current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting.

say_en.text: Set up MCP access to this source for me
say_en.note: Uses host tools; credentials stay on the host

say_en.text: Diagnose why my access to this source fails
say_en.note: Checks capability and reports gaps honestly

say_en.text: What host tools are still missing to reach this source?
say_en.note: Reports missing capability instead of claiming it works
